explication: iodine tunnels IPv4 packets through DNS between a client and iodined server. The main workflow is client setup/authentication and negotiation, packet transfer over DNS-encoded queries and replies, then delivery through each endpoint’s virtual TUN interface. README also documents raw-UDP fallback and query/fragment tuning. The excerpts show endpoint orchestration and parts of the protocol, but not all server/client internals; uncertain relationships are omitted or dashed.
